notes.title: Major Update Arrives in Treasure Mountain!
notes.notes:
[h1]Update Details[/h1]

[h2]Versus Mode[/h2]
Two unique game rules for even more fun!

[h3]Versus Mode ①: "Treasure Race"[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/b351843fd3869378144ffbd5cbb3ddbf07bcec5c.png[/img]
The player who completes the "biggest treasure" faster than their opponent wins!
This thrilling mode tests your speed and decision-making as you race to grow treasures quickly without letting them fall into the sea!

[b]"Treasure Race" Special Rules
[list]
[*] If time runs out, the player with the larger treasure wins.
[*] Dropping treasures off the island doesn’t result in game over; you restart from the state of the largest treasure.
[/list]

[h3]Versus Mode ②: "Score Attack"[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/384393106e4a07fb8d606e9a7a5aed33db31fa64.png[/img]
The player who earns the most points within the time limit wins!
Throw treasures faster than usual and compete in a heated back-and-forth battle for points!

[b]"Score Attack" Special Rules
[list]
[*] Dropping treasures off the island doesn’t result in game over.
[*] Treasures spawn on the island periodically.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]How to Play Versus Mode[/h2]
Versus Mode can be played in three ways:
[olist]
[*] Online matches with friends
[*] Online matches using invitation links
[*] Local matches on a single PC
[/olist]

[h3]Method 1: Online Matches with Friends[/h3]
Play with friends using Steam®'s Remote Play Together feature.
[olist]
[*] From the Treasure Mountain title screen, select "Start Game" > "Versus Play" > "Online Match."
[list]
[*] The [b]Remote Play Together[/b] window will open.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/5d56942db2b07e9f0a0f5e88f229d5e8f61be7f7.png[/img]
[/list]
[*] Select "Invite Friend" from the left menu, and choose a friend from the right-hand list.
[list]
[*] A Steam invitation message will be sent to the selected friend.
[*] Players invited via Remote Play Together can participate even if they don’t own Treasure Mountain.
[/list]
[*] After sending the invite, click "Return to Game" in the top-right corner of the window.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/54464d39303a610530a6a87374d8480ff23ab4f0.png[/img]
[*] Wait on the standby screen for your invited friend to join the game.
[list]
[*] Once your friend joins, their information will appear at the bottom-right of the screen.
[*] Both players (1P/2P) must confirm their input devices to begin the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/99d42b7f924e953015a1196b2055f3332a1dafac.png[/img]
[/list]
[*] Players connecting via Remote Play can only use controllers. Keyboards and mice are not supported.

[*] Select the game mode and start your match.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/450531cf4054de5cdbb19454df5bfe7ced911d76.png[/img]
[/olist]

[h3]Method 2: Online Matches Using Invitation Links[/h3]
Invite non-friends to play by generating an invitation link through Steam®’s Remote Play Together feature.
[olist]
[*] From the title screen, select "Start Game" > "Versus Play" > "Online Match."
[list][*] The [b]Remote Play Together[/b] window will open.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/5d56942db2b07e9f0a0f5e88f229d5e8f61be7f7.png[/img]
[/list]
[*] Open the Remote Play Together window and select "Invite Guest."

[*] Copy the invitation link displayed at the top of the list.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/ed9901dc90c823bc9c40df1c65bb419db41a1225.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Click "Copy" to copy the link.
[/list]
[*] Share the copied link with the opponent.
[list]
[*] Opponents can join Remote Play Together by clicking the link.
[list]
[*] A Steam® account is required for the opponent.
[*] Opponents do not need to own Treasure Mountain to play.
[/list]
[/list]
[*] Click "Return to Game" and wait for your invited player to join.
[list]
[*] When the opponent joins, their information will appear at the bottom-right of the screen.
[/list]
[/olist]

[h3]Method 3: Local Matches on a Single PC[/h3]
Play together on one PC.
[olist]
[*] From the title screen, select "Start Game" > "Versus Play" > "Offline Match."
[*] Confirm input devices for 1P and 2P to begin.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/d7a1a558bdc20d973d43174bea7913aa3417019a.png[/img]
[*] Choose a game mode and start your match.
[/olist]

[h2]Versus Mode Features[/h2]

[h3]Stamps[/h3]
Spice up Versus Mode with adorable and expressive stamps to enhance communication!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/e6a1d819ca806cb6ef4523ae79cc5a993be2c7f0.png[/img]

[h3]Handicap Settings[/h3]
The "Treasure Race" mode includes handicap options for varied player levels, a fun choice for party play!

[h3]Solo Practice[/h3]
A training mode to familiarize yourself with the rules before trying a match.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/39a894b3443626db90b7e3586f2b3f146c644b96.png[/img]

[h2]Versus Mode Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Progress toward unlocking treasures or achievements does not count in Versus Mode.
[*] Players using Remote Play Together must use a controller. Keyboards and mice are not supported.
[*] Due to Remote Play Together restrictions, Mac users cannot host games but can join invitations.
[*] For more details on Remote Play Together, check [url=https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay]Steam Remote Play[/url].
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Unlock Treasures with a Free "Treasure Unlock Ticket"![/h2]
As part of the major update celebration, we’re thrilled to gift every player a special Treasure Unlock Ticket that lets you unlock one unopened treasure!
Use it to unlock your favorite treasure and enjoy Treasure Mountain even more!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/6dc3f20b306a1806cb3d71b9977bcf297959bb02.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Treasure Unlock Tickets can be used in the "Treasure Index" to unlock unopened treasures.
[*] Check your ticket count in the "Treasure Encyclopedia."
[*] Tickets will be distributed during future events on an irregular basis.
[/list]

For more details on Update Ver. 2.0.0, see the patch notes below:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2972990/view/4477236636060483623]Patch Notes Link[/url]

[h2]’Treasure Unlock Ticket’ Now Available[/h2]
The ‘Treasure Unlock Ticket’ is a special ticket that can unlock one locked treasure.
As part of this update celebration, we’re gifting all players one Treasure Unlock Ticket!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/6dc3f20b306a1806cb3d71b9977bcf297959bb02.png[/img]

[*]Treasure Unlock Tickets will be distributed occasionally during future events.
[*]Treasure Unlock Tickets can be used in the ‘Treasure Index’.
[*]When unlocking a treasure with a ticket, its unlock condition will not progress, so you must meet the specified conditions to obtain related Steam achievements.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Default volume settings have been adjusted.
These changes will only apply when new save data is created after the Ver.2.0.0 update.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support of “Hololive Treasure Mountain".

notes.title: More News! Treasure Mountain: Major Update Info Part 2!
notes.notes:
The upcoming 2.0.0 update is scheduled for release on December 3rd.
Let’s take a look at the two new game modes planned for this update.

Versus Mode 1: 'Treasure Race'
The first to complete the "biggest treasure" wins!
This is a fast-paced treasure-making race that requires speed and decision-making.
Be careful not to stack too quickly and let your treasures fall into the sea!

Versus Mode 2: 'Score Attack'
The player who earns the most points within the time limit wins!
In this mode, dropping treasures into the sea won’t end the game, so toss treasures freely and rack up points like crazy!

We’re also planning to add cute stamp features to make the battles even more exciting.
Check out the PV for the Treasure Mountain Major Update for more details!

notes.title: Patch Release Notification (Ver.1.0.1)
notes.notes:
[b]Announcement[/b]
- We have released patch Ver.1.0.1,  which fixes the following issues.


[b]Fix Details[/b]
- We have fixed an issue where the game would set an unintended language based on the Steam application’s language settings, causing the game to malfunction. This issue affected the following languages:
   -    French
   -    Italian
   -   German
   -   Spanish
   -    Portuguese
   -   Russian
   -   Korean
- Please note that there are no issues with Japanese, English, and Chinese (Simplified/Traditional).
    

Additional Information

- We will continue to address other reported bugs and issues as we move forward.


Thank you.
